That depends on what you're after, so here's the general picture. Most people do well with a squat or leg press pattern, a hinge like Romanian deadlifts, something single-leg like split squats, and a little work for hamstring curls and calves. Two leg days a week is plenty for most lifters, with a few hard sets per movement.

If you want me to set up an actual session, say the word, like "give me a leg day", and tell me how much time you've got. I'll have the app build it for you to check and confirm.
